blocks.translation: Wild Arms 5

blocks.source: 質量
blocks.translation: Length

blocks.source: 僕の場合、クリア時間は４０時間程度だった。サブイベントは適当にこなしている。戦闘やストーリーのテンポは後述の通り、そんなによくないので中身の割りに時間がかかったかも。
blocks.translation: In my case, it took about 40 hours to complete. I only completed the side events casually. As mentioned below, the battle and story pacing aren't particularly good, so it may have taken a long time relative to the amount of content.

blocks.source: 物語
blocks.translation: Story

blocks.source: 良く悪くも典型的な王道ストーリーだけど、筆者は王道が好きなので問題なし。
blocks.translation: For better or worse, it's a typical classic adventure story, but I like that kind of story, so I had no problem with it.

blocks.source: 前作ワイルドアームズ４（ＷＡ４）では主人公とヒロインのキャラクターが弱かったように思うけれど、主人公のディーン、ヒロインのレベッカ、アヴリルと個性的。他３人の仲間や敵陣も良いキャラクターが多くいるけれど、エンディングでほとんど無視されていたのが残念。
blocks.translation: I felt that the protagonist and heroine in the previous game, Wild Arms 4 (WA4), were weak characters, but Dean, the protagonist, and Rebecca and Avril, the heroines, are all distinctive. The other three allies and the enemies also include many good characters, but it's a shame that most of them were virtually ignored in the ending.

blocks.source: ストーリーテンポはあんまりよくない。
blocks.translation: The story pacing isn't particularly good.

blocks.source: 後半まで、明確な目的が見えてこず、なかなか盛り上がらない。序盤中盤から１ダンジョンが長め（２時間程度）ということもあって、中だるみしやすい。町と町を結ぶだけの重要度が低いダンジョンが結構多い。
blocks.translation: A clear objective doesn't emerge until the latter half, so the story takes a long time to get exciting. Since each dungeon is fairly long (about two hours) from the early to middle portions, the game is prone to losing momentum. There are also quite a lot of low-importance dungeons that merely connect one town to another.

blocks.source: ＷＡ４は短いと批判を浴びたけど、これはこれで辛いものがある。
blocks.translation: WA4 was criticized for being short, but this has its own difficulties.

blocks.source: 隠し要素やサブイベントが豊富で、いままでのＷＡ１～４の歴代キャラがサブキャラとして、登場するのは嬉しい限り。おまけ要素はなかなか充実している。
blocks.translation: There are plenty of hidden elements and side events, and it's a real pleasure to see characters from previous games in the WA1–4 series appear as supporting characters. The bonus content is quite substantial.

blocks.source: システム
blocks.translation: System

blocks.source: 戦闘システムは前作と同じくＨＥＸバトルシステム。７つのマスを移動しながら戦う。
blocks.translation: The battle system is the HEX Battle System, just like in the previous game. You fight while moving across seven spaces.

blocks.source: 今回からは移動と攻撃が１ターンで同時にできるようになった。快適になってはいるのだが、同時に位置取りの戦略性が薄れてしまった。
blocks.translation: Starting with this game, movement and attacks can be performed during the same turn. This makes things more convenient, but it also reduces the strategic importance of positioning.

blocks.source: 前作であまり機能していなかったバッジシステムだが、（要するにアクセサリを複数装備できるシステム）今回は使えるバッジも増えて機能するようになった。
blocks.translation: The Badge System didn't function very well in the previous game (in short, it's a system that lets you equip multiple accessories), but this time, more usable badges have been added and the system works better.

blocks.source: シリーズおなじみ、ダンジョンの謎解きはわりと面倒かも。単に僕が謎解き嫌いというのもあるかも……。
blocks.translation: As is customary for the series, solving the dungeon puzzles can be rather tedious. Though perhaps that's simply because I don't like puzzles...

blocks.source: バランス
blocks.translation: Balance

blocks.source: 今作では、キャラの戦闘における個性がほとんどなく、１人に付き１つ装備できるミーディアム（職業に相当。全６種類）によって、キャラの能力や技が決定される。大雑把に言うと、ＦＦ３のジョブシステムに近い。
blocks.translation: In this game, the characters have very little individuality in battle. Their abilities and techniques are determined by the Mediums (equivalent to jobs; six types in total), one of which can be equipped by each character. Broadly speaking, it's similar to the job system in FF3.

blocks.source: 戦闘メンバーは３人であるため、３つ分のミーディアムの能力しか使うことができない。６つのミーディアムが持つ技のほとんどはＷＡ４の仲間４人が、持っていた能力であるため、実質的に１戦闘で使える技は、前作の半分になってしまった。特に回復担当のキャラが手持ち無沙汰になりやすい。
blocks.translation: Since there are three battle members, you can only use the abilities of three Mediums. Most of the techniques provided by the six Mediums were abilities possessed by the four allies in WA4, so in practice, the number of techniques available in a single battle has been cut in half compared to the previous game. The character responsible for healing, in particular, often has nothing to do.

blocks.source: 装備を変えてもほとんど能力に変化がないことが多い。後半にようやくそこそこの装備が手に入るけれど、もうちょっと差がついてもよさそうなもの。
blocks.translation: Changing equipment often makes little difference to a character's abilities. You finally obtain decent equipment in the latter half, but it would have been nice if the differences were a little more pronounced.

blocks.source: 一応、戦闘中に仲間の入替ができる。ただ１ターンかかるし、控えキャラの装備まで整えるのは手間なので、あまり使わなかった。
blocks.translation: You can switch party members during battle, at least. However, it takes one turn, and outfitting reserve characters as well is a hassle, so I hardly used it.

blocks.source: ボスを瞬殺できる前作ラクウェルみたいな極端に強いキャラや技はなくなったが、逆にボスがしぶとく時間が掛かる。
blocks.translation: The extremely powerful characters and techniques, like Raquel from the previous game, who could instantly kill bosses, are gone, but the bosses are correspondingly tougher and take longer to defeat.

blocks.source: 途中のボス戦はなかなかの手応えだけど、ラスボスは非常に弱いし攻撃も単調。
blocks.translation: The battles against the mid-game bosses are quite challenging, but the final boss is extremely weak and has a monotonous attack pattern.

blocks.source: 戦闘システムは凝っているのに、それを発揮できないまま終わるのはどうも寂しい。毎度の通り、ラスボスより強いボスが大量にいるけれど、やっぱりそれよりは強いラスボスを作って欲しいなあと。
blocks.translation: It's a little disappointing that the game ends without letting the elaborate battle system really shine. As usual, there are many bosses stronger than the final boss, but I still wish they had made the final boss stronger than those bosses.

blocks.source: 快適性
blocks.translation: Comfort

blocks.source: メニュー画面で装備を変更する際に、装備の画像データを読み込むのにロードが入るため気になる。
blocks.translation: When changing equipment on the menu screen, the game loads the equipment's image data, which is noticeable.

blocks.source: 戦闘テンポはＷＡ４と比べて悪化した部分。エンカウント率が高めなのに戦闘開始まで１０秒かかる。
blocks.translation: The battle pacing is one area that has worsened compared to WA4. Despite the relatively high encounter rate, it takes 10 seconds for a battle to begin.

blocks.source: また、行動時になにかと間が入るようになった。特に通常攻撃は前作はＦＦＸに匹敵するほどスピーディだったのに……。
blocks.translation: Actions have also started to include pauses here and there. Normal attacks in particular were so speedy in the previous game that they rivaled FFX...

blocks.source: オプションで戦闘アニメはカットできるけれど、演出も何もなくダメージだけ表示されるのは寂しい。
blocks.translation: You can skip battle animations in the options, but it's disappointing when the game simply displays the damage without any presentation or effects.

blocks.source: 町とフィールドの出入りには１０秒以上のロードがかかる。後半やり込もうとすれば、町とフィールドの出入りは多くなるため、これには悩まされる。
blocks.translation: Entering and leaving towns and fields takes more than 10 seconds to load. If you try to thoroughly play through the latter half, you'll be entering and leaving towns and fields frequently, so this becomes a real nuisance.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: 作曲はなるけみちこ氏ではなくなったが、意外にも素晴らしい出来。というか今までのシリーズで最高レベルかも。数も豊富で、敵四天王全てに専用戦闘曲があったり、大陸ごとにフィールド曲が変わる凝り具合。
blocks.translation: Michiko Naruke is no longer the composer, but the result is surprisingly wonderful. In fact, it may be the highest quality in the series so far. There are plenty of tracks, too, with dedicated battle themes for all four enemy generals and different field music for each continent, showing a great deal of attention to detail.
